name: Toaru Kagaku no Railgun
original_name: とある化学の超電磁砲
source:
There are so many temptations at Academy City.
That Level 5 girl Misaka with those sexy looks...
Her Judgment roommate Kuroko...

No more fantasizing! I'll make the girls mine... 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE054879.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
学园都市里充满了诱惑。
那位身材性感的超能力者（Level 5）御坂美琴……
还有身为风纪委员、与她同住的白井黑子……

我不会再沉溺于幻想！我要让她们成为我的女人……

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE054879.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
